rationale: The current 8.8 Premier aggregate lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The detailed task requires Cloud 10.2+, ES 8.7+, an enabled assistant, SOAR pairing, existing AI-triaged findings, first-ten burst and about 200 daily findings per tenant, frontier models and inherited investigation/action/asset permissions. The 8.7 task keeps its historical AI SOC analyst title and Cloud scope. The current 8.8 editions and regional tables keep the combined workflow under Premier and qualify deployment differences. November 4 GA supersedes the product CA milestone without proving rollout. The CMP task specifies Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0. The separate setup path is indexed-only and names SAIA 2.4+, while the installation material rules out Cloud Connected in 2.2–2.3.6 and describes 2.4 as planned and the 2.1.1 workaround as lacking Agent Mode. The usable CMP path remains unconfirmed.
